text: A customer buys a dress at the counter.
Dami opens Sell from the tools.
The Ankara dress comes in sizes and colours. Tap Choose, then pick size 12 and Gold.
It shows 12, Gold and how many are left. Add one.
The bar shows one thing and ₦28,000. Tap Next.
Choose how it was paid: Transfer. Tap Record the sale. It is saved, and stock goes down.
